scoreDocumentation.purpose: Tranche 0 human-centered UX baseline. Baseline may fail final UX thresholds; route/safety hard failures still fail.
scoreDocumentation.v2Delta: Deltas are computed from the same route/scenario/viewport score rows for V2 and explicit V3.
